notes.subject: adɛn na aw bɛna tubu
notes.rationale: כתב 1:5 alu 3:19 'a dun': daɲɛ in tɛ kelen-kelen bɛn — 'why should ye be stricken' (KJV) walima 'aw bɛ yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma don dɔrɔn' (A	Sıħı a ka da pɔɔɔɔɔɔɔ

notes.subject: kun bɛɛ dun bana
notes.rationale: Heburu: 'kun bɛɛ bana dɔrɔn' — i n'a fɔ Kuma-mɔgɔw ka misali; dibiya-bɔ la, Bamanankan bɛ 'dun' fɔ ka a jira ko sabu-yɛlɛma dɔ bɛ yen.

notes.subject: aw
notes.rationale: Yeshayahu bɛ Yerushalayim mɔgɔw ni Yuda-siya wele — 1:1 ka 'kalanbaga' mɔgɔw.

translation: Adɛn na aw bɛna tubu min kɔnɔ kɔrɔ? Aw bɛ yɛlɛma-yɛlɛma fara a kan kokura; kun bɛɛ dun bana bɛ o la, ani dusukun bɛɛ dun bɛ cɛɛsɔrɔ.

tokens.gloss: aw bɛ fara a kan kokura
